critical_code_review_comments: engine.py Phase 2 wiring: all 5 enrichers are guarded by try/except that only logs at debug level. This is correct for a production-safe additive pipeline, but means silent enricher regressions would only surface via missing signal points. Consider bumping to logger.warning for repeated per-pick failures (>=N in a slate).

soccer_rolling_xg.enrich_pick_with_rolling_xg: falls back to form_proxy when the dedicated soccer_team_xg collection is empty. That path is correct, but pick['xg_rolling'] then contains {'home': {...proxy...}, 'away': None} when only home has form data — downstream calculators should tolerate half-populated blocks (verified by unit test that a fully-populated pick works; edge case with only one side present isn't covered by a live pick yet).

mlb_bvp.lookup_bat_side / _BAT_SIDE_CACHE: the batter-hand piggyback on the MLB StatsAPI /people/search call means bat-side resolution depends on that path being exercised. If BVP lookup is skipped (e.g., off-season), park_hr_hand_factor will legitimately be None for the whole slate — which matches the current observed behaviour and is documented in the PRD as expected.
